lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now I have to go to Cali.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Isn’t there a need for that…? .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Welcome.
(A woman with pointy ears is walking slowly from the entrance to White Coal Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long time no see. Swordsman. How long has it been since this... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It seems like it's been 145 years, 5 months and 3 days since we last met.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So much time has already passed... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: At that time, Kali’s traditional liquor was very impressive. If you get the chance, please invite me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're talking about the alcohol that no one drinks because it's so strong. Unfortunately, there are none left.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Shinik will be surprised to hear that you, the recluse in the corner of your room, have come out. He might come all the way from Tartarus all the way here.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's been a while since we last met, let's stop getting nervous.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Then tell me straight away.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You know this, right? What did Daphne do... ?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I was suspicious when the Sword God found out the truth hidden by the Flame of Truth.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Still, I believed it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He said she was like a mother to me and that I was a witch... . I simply thought they were beings with different powers.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: However, I found out after %s visited Kali at the request of the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Daphne hid a lot from me. And that there are a lot of witches.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I feel sorry for Daphne, but I don't want to take that feeling out on you. Do you know anything more?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What is certain is that there are 'witches' who have similar purposes to her. And there are some who haven't been seen for a long time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What a pain in the ass, you witch… . Perhaps they are beings similar to or greater than superhumans.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know if %s knows this too. Because He knows ‘Walpurgis Night’.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: First, we have to solve what Weiss is trying to do. And I want to ask you something. Medea, you… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: So when will you give him a trace of superhuman strength?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: And how long are you going to deny yourself?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea, no… . Medea.
